articles.title: This Old Dollar Store Is Now a Free Store — and a Roller Rink!
articles.summary: In New Orleans, a graffiti-covered old Family Dollar is now the New Orleans Free Store. Everything inside is free — clothes, toys, food. Twice a week, people even roller skate on the smooth floor.

articles.title: US and Denmark Make a Deal About Greenland
articles.summary: The US and Denmark have agreed on a deal about Greenland's security. It comes after President Trump threatened to take Greenland by force. Nato says the deal will help keep the Arctic stable.

articles.title: Congo Starts Ebola Vaccines for Health Workers in Outbreak Center
articles.summary: Congo has begun vaccinating health workers against Ebola in Bunia, the center of the fastest-growing outbreak ever. The virus is a type called Bundibugyo, which has no licensed vaccine yet.
